names.note: Read out of the Ohrid Prologue's fourth heading for the Julian 22 February on pravoslavno.rs, „Свети Папије Јерапољски.“, with Свети left off, which is not a rank. The heading carries the city as part of the form and no rank word at all, so the form is kept whole; nothing in the entry names him a bishop.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for 22 февраля ст. ст., which is the page for this menologion number.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for 22 februarie, which is the page for this menologion number — not 7 martie, which merely shares his civil date in 2026.

Not checked: saint.gr's εορτολόγιο for 22 Φεβρουαρίου, which is the page for this menologion number — not 03/07, which merely shares his civil date in 2026. The corpus holds two other folders for men of this name, `papias` on the Greek and Romanian 28 June and `papias-20-november` among a company on the Greek 20 November; neither is this man, who is a writer of the generation after the apostles and not a martyr under Diocletian.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 07.03.2026 (22. фебруар ст. ст.) — „Свети Папије Јерапољски.“

attestations.note: The day's fourth and last entry, and two sentences long. The Prologue is the only one of the four calendars read for him.
